lines.en: label makiinv3:
I tap on Maki’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Maki 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: She hasn’t been back at my house ever since the impromptu semi-kidnapping that resulted in me failing (At least by my definition) to cheer up Makoto, so I figure I should invite her back now that things are...
lines.zh: 自从那次临时起意的半绑架事件之后——那次我（至少按我自己的标准）没能哄好 Makoto——她就再没来过我家，所以我想，既然现在情况已经……

lines.en: Well, less horrible.
lines.zh: 嗯，没那么糟了。

lines.en: Of course there will be some lingering pain for lifetimes to come, but who says you can’t counteract some of that with a little quality time?
lines.zh: 当然，往后余生仍会留下些挥之不去的痛楚，可谁说不能用一点高质量的相处时光来抵消一部分呢？

lines.en: : Hello?
: Hey. On a scale of one to ten, how miserable are you today?
lines.zh: : 嘿。一到十打分的话，你今天有多痛苦？

lines.en: : On the inside or on the outside?
lines.zh: : 内心还是外表？

lines.en: : Uhh...both?
lines.zh: : 呃……都算？

lines.en: : Eight and four. Why? Do you need a dildo? We offer delivery now.
lines.zh: : 八分和四分。怎么？你需要假阳具吗？我们现在支持外送了。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine there is very much demand for that.
lines.zh: : 我想那玩意儿需求应该不大吧。

lines.en: : The market for dildo delivery is actually surprisingly large.
lines.zh: : 假阳具外送的市场其实大得惊人。

lines.en: : That aside, would you want to come hang out at my place? I can’t guarantee that I can do anything for you on the inside, but I might be able to bring that external misery down to a three.
lines.zh: : 先不说这个，你想来我家待会儿吗？我保证不了能治好你的内心，但也许能把外在的痛苦降到三分。

lines.en: : Is that so? I think I might have to take you up on your offer then.
lines.zh: : 是吗？那我想我大概得接受你的邀请了。

lines.en: : This actually works out really well. I had something to do in that area already.
lines.zh: : 其实时间刚刚好。我本来就有点事要去那一带。

lines.en: : It’s not dildo delivery, is it?
lines.zh: : 该不会是送假阳具吧？

lines.en: : Nah, it’s nothing that fun. I’m dropping Makoto off for a therapy session.
lines.zh: : 不是，没那么好玩。我是送 Makoto 去做心理咨询。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Yeah, that’s not fun at all.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那可一点都不好玩。

lines.en: : But good for her.
lines.zh: : 不过对她来说是好事。

lines.en: : Yup! I’ll be over in about...half an hour?
lines.zh: : 嗯！我大概……半小时后到？

lines.en: : Sounds good. See you soon.
lines.zh: : 好。待会儿见。

lines.en: : Yup! See you!
lines.zh: : 嗯！回头见！

lines.en: scene black
I hang up the phone and decide to crash on the couch until Maki gets here.
lines.zh: 我挂断电话，决定先在沙发上瘫着，等 Maki 过来。

lines.en: scene makivisits1
I spring up from the couch as soon as I hear a knock on the door, hoping I’m able to let Maki in and hide from Ami before that’s a thing I have to deal with today.
lines.zh: 一听到敲门声我就从沙发上弹了起来，希望能在「今天还得应付 Ami」这件事发生之前，先把 Maki 让进来并把她藏好。

lines.en: Should I have waited until Ami was {i}gone{/i} to invite Maki over? Yes.
lines.zh: 我是不是该等 Ami {i}出门{/i}再叫 Maki 过来？是。

lines.en: But part of me doubts she’ll put up much of a fight considering that she now understands everything that happened.
lines.zh: 但我有一部分觉得，既然她现在已经明白了一切经过，应该不会闹得太凶。

lines.en: Only part of me, though.
lines.zh: 不过只是「一部分」而已。

lines.en: This could very well still end extremely poorly.
lines.zh: 这事仍然很有可能以极其糟糕的方式收场。

lines.en: scene makivisits2
: Hey. Thanks for the invite.
lines.zh: : 嘿。谢谢你的邀请。

lines.en: : I was starting to worry that I’d never be invited back after the whole kidnapping thing.
lines.zh: : 绑架那事之后，我还开始担心自己再也收不到邀请了呢。

lines.en: : To be fair, that was a situation in which you weren’t invited at all. So I would think that it wouldn’t even matter if I were to invite you or not.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，那次你本来就没被邀请。所以我觉得我邀不邀请你根本无关紧要。

lines.en: : I guess it doesn’t. I like to keep my home intrusion to a minimum, though.
lines.zh: : 大概确实无关紧要。不过我还是喜欢把「闯入别人家」的次数控制在最低限度。

lines.en: : Probably a good call. Do you have a time limit today?
lines.zh: : 明智。你今天有时间限制吗？

lines.en: scene makivisits3
: Time limit?
lines.zh: : 时间限制？

lines.en: : You know...since you dropped Makoto off?
lines.zh: : 你知道的……你不是把 Makoto 送过来了吗？

lines.en: : I kind of figured you’d have to go pick her up as well.
lines.zh: : 我猜你待会儿还得去接她。

lines.en: : Oh, don’t worry about that. She’s a lot closer than you think.
lines.zh: : 哦，这个不用担心。她比你想象得要近得多。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene makivisits4
: Please don’t tell me I’m the therapist.
lines.zh: : 别告诉我那个咨询师是我。

lines.en: : Hey, I just said it was a therapy {i}session.{/i} I never said there was a therapist involved.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我只说了是{i}心理咨询{/i}。我可没说有心理医生参与。

lines.en: scene makivisits5
: But, no. Makoto is here to see someone else. So you and me can hang out until she’s ready to leave. Such a convenient coincidence, right?
lines.zh: : 不过不是。Makoto 是来找别人的。所以你我可以一直待到她准备离开为止。多巧的巧合啊，对吧？

lines.en: : Maybe a little too convenient...
lines.zh: : 巧得有点过头了吧……

lines.en: scene makivisits6
: Why, hello there. Are you ready for today’s session, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你好呀。准备好今天的咨询了吗，Makoto？

lines.en: : Can you not call it that? I just want to talk without feeling like I’m totally and irreversibly broken.
lines.zh: : 你能别这么叫吗？我只想聊聊天，不想觉得自己已经彻底碎了、再也修不好了。

lines.en: scene makivisits7
: Sure! Come on, I’ll show you my room.
lines.zh: : 好呀！走吧，我带你去看我的房间。

lines.en: : Maybe keep the door cracked open a little. That look you just gave my daughter a second ago has me questioning just what type of therapist you are.
lines.zh: : 门最好留条缝。你刚才看我女儿那眼神，让我忍不住怀疑你到底是哪种心理医生。

lines.en: scene makivisits8
: Can you maybe, like...{i}not{/i} ruin this before it even starts? I’m uncomfortable enough as is.
lines.zh: : 你能不能……{i}别{/i}在还没开始之前就把它搞砸？我已经够不自在了。

lines.en: : You two can close the door, it’s fine. Just don’t lock it because we’ll be listening closely.
lines.zh: : 你们俩可以把门关上，没关系。只是别反锁，因为我们会仔细听着。

lines.en: scene makivisits9
: Uhh...please don’t.
lines.zh: : 呃……求你们别听。

lines.en: scene makivisits10
Makoto and Ami disappear into Ami’s bedroom- which is a thing I never thought I would say, but here we are.
lines.zh: Makoto 和 Ami 消失在了 Ami 的卧室里——这句话我从没想过会从我嘴里说出来，可我们就是到了这一步。

lines.en: I guess the fruits of tragedy can be a little surprising after repeatedly kicking its tree and hoping for something else to fall.
lines.zh: 我想，在你一遍遍踹那棵悲剧之树、盼着掉下来点别的东西之后，结出的果实多少会出人意料。

lines.en: : Makoto told me all about how Ami was able to help her when she ran away to school the other day.
lines.zh: Makoto 跟我说了那天她逃去学校时，Ami 是怎么帮她的。

lines.en: : Of all the people, who would’ve thought she’d be the one to throw her one of those...life saving, floaty tube things.
lines.zh: : 那么多人里，谁能想到会是她朝她扔过去那么一个……救命的游泳圈。

lines.en: : They’ve found one more thing they have in common, I guess...albeit not a very good thing.
lines.zh: : 看来她们又找到了一个共同点……虽说不是什么好事。

lines.en: if kirinkill == False:
: Though, I find it a little strange how Ami was able to do something for her Miku {i}wasn’t{/i} when both of them have dealt with the deaths of their parents.
lines.zh: : 不过我有点奇怪，Ami 和 Miku 都经历过父母离世，怎么反倒是 Ami 做到了 Miku {i}没做到{/i}的事。

lines.en: : True. Miku’s case is a little different from most, though.
lines.zh: : 确实。不过 Miku 的情况跟大多数人不太一样。

lines.en: : In a lot of ways, she hasn’t really processed things either.
lines.zh: : 在很多方面，她也并没有真正消化掉那些事。

lines.en: : And while I have no idea what your niece’s situation is like, it seems that she was able to tell it to Makoto straight without having to hide everything behind a bunch of walls she put up.
lines.zh: : 虽然我完全不了解你侄女的情况，但看起来她能把话说给 Makoto 听，直截了当，不用把一切都藏在她自己砌起的高墙后面。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say Ami has really processed things either. She still breaks down every now and then.
lines.zh: : 我也不会说 Ami 真的消化掉了。她偶尔还是会崩溃。

lines.en: : I think it’s kind of impossible for anyone that young to truly process something like this. It’ll be years before any of those girls can talk about it without bursting into tears.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那么小的孩子，本来就不可能真正消化这种事。要过好多年，那些女孩才能谈起它而不掉眼泪。

lines.en: : For now, though...I say we let them be. They’ll help each other...they’ll connect with each other...and we’ll be here to plug them back in if they ever get disconnected.
lines.zh: : 不过现在……我说就随她们去吧。她们会互相帮助……会彼此相连……而如果哪天断线了，我们还在这儿，可以把她们重新插上。

lines.en: else:
: Yeah...I guess so.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概吧。

lines.en: : It pains me to say this as even {i}I’m{/i} starting to see her as a bit of rival, but Ami’s a good girl.
lines.zh: : 说这话让我挺难受的，毕竟连{i}我{/i}都开始有点把她当对手看了，但 Ami 是个好女孩。

lines.en: : Why would you ever see Ami as a rival?
lines.zh: : 你怎么会把 Ami 当成对手？

lines.en: : I have no idea. But every time I’m around her, I keep wanting to put her in her place.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。可每次跟她待在一起，我就忍不住想让她知道自己几斤几两。

lines.en: : It’s starting to make a little sense why you wanted to keep the door cracked...
lines.zh: : 我开始有点明白你为什么想让门留条缝了……

lines.en: scene black
Maki takes a seat at the kitchen table.
lines.zh: Maki 在餐桌旁坐了下来。

lines.en: I offer her something to drink but she respectfully declines as scattered but pained laughs play quietly in the background.
lines.zh: 我拿了点喝的给她，她礼貌地谢绝了，与此同时背景里断断续续地传来带着痛楚的笑声。

lines.en: I turn on the TV to mask them as invading their respective privacies now would do me no good. And curiosity is only beneficial when there is something to be gained from its existence.
lines.zh: 我打开电视盖住那些声音，因为现在去侵犯她们各自的隐私对我毫无好处。好奇心只有在能从中有所收获时才有价值。

lines.en: I will gain nothing from the acute awareness of the suffering of girls that I care for.
lines.zh: 清醒地意识到我在意的女孩们正在受苦，我不会从中得到任何东西。

lines.en: But they have everything to gain from one another.
lines.zh: 但她们能从彼此身上得到一切。

lines.en: Which is why I wouldn’t mind if they locked the door.
lines.zh: 所以就算她们把门锁上，我也不会介意。

lines.en: scene makivisits11
: I’ve gotta say...your family’s been really good at bailing me out lately. This single mother thing isn’t easy. Especially when your relationship with your daughter is already all over the place.
lines.zh: : 我得说……最近你们家真是没少帮我收拾烂摊子。单亲妈妈这活儿不容易。尤其是你跟女儿的关系本来就一团乱的时候。

lines.en: : I’ve got no idea how Sara does it. Especially after losing one of her kids.
lines.zh: : 我真不知道 Sara 是怎么撑过来的。尤其是她还失去了一个孩子。

lines.en: : I think you’ll be fine. Things already seem to be getting a little better with you two.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你会没事的。你们俩的情况看起来已经在好转了。

lines.en: : Things {i}are{/i} a little better. We had dinner together for the first time in what feels like years last night.
lines.zh: : {i}是{/i}好了一点。昨晚我们一起吃了顿晚饭，感觉是多年来的第一次。

lines.en: : Granted, it was a just a pizza we had delivered. But hey, baby steps are fine for now. We’ll be able to walk on our own two feet again in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 虽说只是叫了个外卖披萨。不过嘛，眼下能迈出一小步就挺好了。用不了多久，我们就能重新靠自己的双脚走路了。

lines.en: : And all that lashing out in the beginning...while it hurt at the time...I get it now.
lines.zh: : 还有一开始那些乱发脾气……当时虽然很伤人……现在我能理解了。

lines.en: : I probably would have done the same if either of my parents died when I was Makoto’s age. But, then again, I was never really as close to either of them as she was with her dad.
lines.zh: : 要是我父母在我像 Makoto 那么大的时候去世，我大概也会那样。不过话说回来，我跟他们俩的关系从来都不像她跟她爸那么亲。

lines.en: : And, you know...while this is still one of the worst things that’s ever happened to me...part of me feels a little relieved.
lines.zh: : 而且，你知道……尽管这仍然是我这辈子遇过最糟的事之一……我有一部分却觉得松了口气。

lines.en: : I’ve got nothing left to dread anymore.
lines.zh: : 我再也没有什么可以恐惧的了。

lines.en: : I don’t have to worry about the slow creep of tragedy in watching everyone I care about get older since everyone but Makoto is already gone- and I’m going to die {i}way{/i} before her.
lines.zh: : 我不用再担心看着在意的人一点点变老、悲剧慢慢爬过来，因为除了 Makoto，其他人已经都不在了——而我{i}肯定{/i}会比她先死。

lines.en: : I'm pretty sure there should have been some knocking on wood there.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你这句话后面该敲敲木头才对。

lines.en: scene makivisits12
: Heh. Wood.
lines.zh: : 呵。木头。

lines.en: : But what about you? Anyone you’re dreading the eventual loss of?
lines.zh: : 那你呢？有没有什么人是你害怕终有一天会失去的？

lines.en: : Wow, what a fun conversation topic you’ve chosen.
lines.zh: : 哇，你可真会挑话题。

lines.en: : Hey, we’ve got a few hours to kill. We might as well get all of the dark stuff out of the way now so we can get back to talking about the {i}real{/i} main topic today — dildo delivery.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我们还有好几个小时要打发。不如趁现在把沉重的话题都聊完，好回到今天{i}真正{/i}的主线上——假阳具外送。

lines.en: : Main topic aside...
lines.zh: : 先不提主线……

lines.en: : I guess there {i}is{/i} someone.
lines.zh: : 大概{i}有{/i}那么一个人吧。

lines.en: : Mother? Father? Sister? Brother?
lines.zh: : 妈妈？爸爸？姐妹？兄弟？

lines.en: : None of the above.
lines.zh: : 都不是。

lines.en: : It’s kind of complicated, really.
lines.zh: : 其实挺复杂的。

lines.en: : Are you going to tell me? Or am I going to have to keep naming potential relationships you may have in hopes of getting it right?
lines.zh: : 你要告诉我吗？还是我得继续报出你可能的人际关系，指望蒙对？

lines.en: : You can name as many “potential relationships” as you want, but the unfortunate truth is that I have no idea what I'd even {i}call{/i} a relationship like this.
lines.zh: : 你想报多少「人际关系」都行，可不幸的事实是，我根本不知道这种关系该{i}叫{/i}什么。

lines.en: scene makivisits13
: Wow. That {i}does{/i} sound complicated.
lines.zh: : 哇。那听上去{i}确实{/i}复杂。

lines.en: : Even that doesn’t really begin to describe it. I guess I see your point, though. Not having to worry about that anymore does sound like it would be a load off of my back.
lines.zh: : 连这都不足以形容。不过我想我明白你的意思了。不用再为这种事担心，听起来确实像是卸下了一副重担。

lines.en: : I’m just...okay with carrying that load for now, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我只是……现在还愿意背着这副担子吧，大概。

lines.en: scene makivisits14
: Yeah...if that were an option for me, I would have done the same without even giving it a second thought.
lines.zh: : 嗯……如果我有得选，我也会毫不犹豫地这么做。

lines.en: : It’s kind of crazy how much my life has changed recently despite it having been me and- uhh, {i}Makoto and me{/i} on our own for over three years now.
lines.zh: : 明明三年多来一直是我和——呃，{i}Makoto 和我{/i}两个人相依为命，最近我的生活却变了这么多，想想真是不可思议。

lines.en: : Knowing that Masahiro is dead completely changes everything even when we’ve been “alone” all this time.
lines.zh: : 就算我们一直都算是「孤零零」的，可知道 Masahiro 死了，一切都彻底不一样了。

lines.en: : So now I’ve...just got a {i}new{/i} load to carry, I guess.
lines.zh: : 所以现在……我{i}又多了{/i}一副要背的担子吧，大概。

lines.en: : Heh. Load.
lines.zh: : 呵。一发。

lines.en: : Comparing single parenthood to semen seems low for even you, Maki.
lines.zh: : 把单亲家长比作精液，就算是你也太低俗了吧，Maki。

lines.en: : Come on, man. Laughs are going to be few and far between for me from now on. You’ve gotta let me have moments like that.
lines.zh: : 拜托，老兄。从今往后我能笑的机会可不多。这种时刻你总得让我占一回吧。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll laugh just as much as you always do. There just might be some...melancholy mixed in with everything now.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定你还是会像往常一样爱笑。只是现在所有事情里可能都掺了点……忧伤。

lines.en: : Maybe you’re right...
lines.zh: : 也许你是对的……

lines.en: : Maybe I’m just worried right now that things are going to permanently change because of how different and horrible everything feels all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 也许我只是现在有点担心，因为一切突然变得这么陌生、这么糟糕，事情会就此永久改变。

lines.en: : But before that, there were {i}other{/i} worries. And if this one fades as well, I’m sure even more will take its place.
lines.zh: : 但在这之前，也有{i}别的{/i}烦恼。如果这一个也淡去了，我敢肯定还会有更多取而代之。

lines.en: : Isn’t it weird, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 这不奇怪吗，老师？

lines.en: : How your worries become amplified the moment you’re all someone has left?
lines.zh: : 一旦你成了某个人仅剩的全部，你的烦恼就会被放大成什么样？

lines.en: : Yeah...the girl giving your daughter “therapy” right now intentionally reinforces that idea nearly every single day for me.
lines.zh: : 是啊……此刻正在给你女儿做「咨询」的那个女孩，几乎每天都在刻意向我强化这个念头。

lines.en: : You should be glad she does. For it’s that exact sort of thing that will keep us alive longer since we’re no longer living for just ourselves.
lines.zh: : 你应该为此高兴才对。因为正是这种东西能让我们活得更久——既然我们不再只是为自己而活。

lines.en: A moment of silence passes.
lines.zh: 一段沉默流过。

lines.en: Then, a set of unexpected words bent into the shape of an anecdote — pouring from the mouth of a woman who laughs at dick jokes — makes me realize just who she is beneath her skin.
lines.zh: 接着，一段出人意料的话语被折成轶事的形状，从一个会为鸡巴笑话发笑的女人口中倾泻而出，让我意识到在她皮囊之下究竟是怎样一个人。

lines.en: It’s someone far more beautiful than I could have ever imagined.
lines.zh: 那是一个远比我想象中更美的人。

lines.en: : You want to know the weirdest change that’s come from all of this?...
lines.zh: : 你想知道这一切带来的最奇怪的变化是什么吗？……

lines.en: : There’s a one way road not far from the shop that I have to cross to get to the local corner store.
lines.zh: : 离店不远有条单行道，我要去街角那家小店就得横穿它。

lines.en: : Before my husband died, I’d only look to the left when crossing since that’s where all of the cars come from.
lines.zh: : 我丈夫去世前，过马路时我只往左看，因为车都从那边来。

lines.en: scene makivisits15
: But now...I look to the right as well.
lines.zh: : 可现在……我也会往右看。

lines.en: : Just to be sure.
lines.zh: : 只是为了确定。

lines.en: scene black
Maki and I remain at the table for another couple hours until Makoto and Ami emerge from the bedroom.
lines.zh: 我和 Maki 又在桌边待了几个小时，直到 Makoto 和 Ami 从卧室里出来。

lines.en: Both of their eyes are red from crying.
lines.zh: 她们俩的眼睛都哭红了。

lines.en: But for a brief moment, a slight smile spreads across Makoto’s face.
lines.zh: 但有那么一瞬间，一丝微笑在 Makoto 脸上绽开。

lines.en: When I look toward Maki to see if she notices, I catch a glimpse of a thin layer of fluid beginning to form over her eyes.
lines.zh: 我朝 Maki 看去，想确认她有没有注意到，却瞥见一层薄薄的液体正开始在她的眼眶上聚起。

lines.en: I get lost somewhere between aquamarine and turquoise.
lines.zh: 我在蓝绿与青绿之间的某个地方迷失了片刻。

lines.en: But I find myself just in time to watch her ruffle her daughter’s hair as the two of them leave my home.
lines.zh: 但我及时回过神来，刚好看到她揉了揉女儿的头发，然后两人离开了我家。

lines.en: : They’ll be okay, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 她们会没事的，老师……

lines.en: : Just like us...
lines.zh: : 就像我们一样……

lines.en: I follow suit and ruffle Ami’s hair as well.
lines.zh: 我也照做，揉了揉 Ami 的头发。

lines.en: And then I manage to get to sleep without my mind wandering off the deep end once more.
lines.zh: 然后我总算睡着了，脑子没有又一次滑向深渊。
